cultural.vision_reason: A handwoven cream cotton blanket with red stripes and a supplementary-weft (khit) band of stylized motifs at one end, consistent with traditional Lanna (northern Thai) textile weaving techniques and blanket types.

physical.title: blanket
physical.summary: A blanket; made of two equal sized pieces of natural cream tabby cotton cloth with red stripes and woven patterning at one end.  Eight red stripes (three fine stripes in each) across the cloth; extended tabby patterning, creating textured cloth.  At one end warp is cut and cloth turned and hand stitched.  At the other end are two bands, 4.5 cms deep in total, 10.5 cms from the warp end: one band has a line of black stylized floral motifs (inner) and the other band has the appearance of red columns and arches; all worked in supplementary weft, 'khit', using red and black stranded cotton yarn.  Overhand knot at fell of cloth; fringes loose.  Blanket unused.
